papers.title: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
papers.desc: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks.

papers.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
papers.desc: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers.

papers.title: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
papers.desc: Peer review relies on several readers finding different problems.

papers.title: Online Mistake Detection in Instruction-Conditioned Procedural Video
papers.desc: An assistant monitoring a person performing a procedure is most useful when it can detect mistakes while there is still time to recover.

papers.title: Direct3D-V3: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers in the Native Voxel Domain
papers.desc: Native 3D generation has largely been built around latent diffusion, with recent advances concentrating on stronger variational autoencoders (VAE) and increasingly elaborate latent representations, from vecset and triplanes to structured sparse voxels.

papers.title: Phantom Success, Silent Failure: Auditing the Success Checkers of Simulated Manipulation Benchmarks
papers.desc: Simulated manipulation benchmarks measure policy performance using hand-written success checkers that label each episode as a success or failure.

papers.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
papers.desc: Language models are trained once, frozen and deployed: improving one again takes another training run, and a prompt, a scaffold or extra computation at inference is gone once the task ends.

papers.title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
papers.desc: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs).

papers.title: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
papers.desc: Pretrained language models (LMs) remain unreliable on exact multi-digit arithmetic without gradient fine-tuning or external tool interpreters.

papers.title: Do Probing and Steering Favor the Same Directions Within and Across Language Models?
papers.desc: A direction in a language model's hidden state can be used to probe whether a concept is present or to steer the model toward it.

papers.title: Squoosh Bench: Evaluating UX-1 on 318 Historical Website A/B Tests
papers.desc: Experimentation teams must decide which proposed website changes to test with live traffic.

papers.title: In Situ Training of Optical Neural Networks by Coding Agents
papers.desc: Optical neural networks promise fast, energy-efficient computing, but every device departs from its design and must be trained with the hardware.

papers.title: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
papers.desc: Current audio-driven video diffusion models can synthesize realistic talking-head videos but generally require dozens of diffusion denoising steps over multi-second video chunks, making them unsuitable for streaming applications such as voice assistants and virtual avatars, where low-latency and online causal generation are required properties.

papers.title: SpecWM: Turning Verification into Refinement for Streaming World Models
papers.desc: Recently, video world models have advanced interactive generation, with large models offering higher quality and smaller models enabling faster inference.

papers.title: Lang-SVG: Hierarchical Image Vectorization with Language Priors
papers.desc: Image vectorization reconstructs raster images as compact scalable vector graph- ics (SVG), providing a structured and editable code representation of images.
